description: This file defines a Water class within the UnityStandardAssets.Water namespace that manages water rendering effects such as reflection and refraction in a Unity game. It includes methods for setting up reflection/refraction cameras, updating shader keywords, and handling water modes.

classes.name: Water
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour class that handles water surface rendering, including reflection and refraction effects, shader keyword management, and water mode configuration.

methods.name: OnWillRenderObject
methods.description: Handles rendering reflections and refractions for the water object during rendering callbacks.

methods.name: OnDisable
methods.description: Cleans up textures and cameras created for reflection and refraction when the component is disabled.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates shader parameters for wave animation effects based on material properties.

methods.name: UpdateCameraModes
methods.description: Synchronizes camera settings from the main camera to reflection/refraction cameras.

methods.name: CreateWaterObjects
methods.description: Creates or reuses reflection and refraction cameras and render textures as needed.

methods.name: GetWaterMode
methods.description: Returns the effective water mode considering hardware support and user setting.

methods.name: FindHardwareWaterSupport
methods.description: Determines the hardware support level for reflection/refraction effects based on the current material.

methods.name: CameraSpacePlane
methods.description: Calculates the plane in camera space used for reflection and refraction clipping.

methods.name: CalculateReflectionMatrix
methods.description: Computes a reflection matrix around a given plane.
